protocol.catalog: TMDB films with positive train interactions only
protocol.exclusions: favorites only; lower ratings are not exclusions
protocol.cohort: users with train favorites and at least one validation target in the catalog
protocol.main_metrics: catalog targets only; unweighted mean across the same eligible users
protocol.metrics_all_targets: all validation targets for the same eligible users, including unavailable films
protocol.recall: hits in the first k ranks divided by the number of distinct targets
protocol.ndcg: binary gain / log2(rank + 1); ideal ranking has min(k, target count) hits
protocol.empty_predictions: keep eligible users with zero scores; do not pad partial or empty rankings
protocol.genres_fit: TF-IDF fitted on canonical metadata of the shared train catalog only; IMAX excluded
protocol.test_usage: not used to fit, select or score any candidate
protocol.als_fit: binary positive train matrix; implicit applies alpha once at fit and profile recalculation
protocol.als_inference: request favorites only, with recalculate_user=True; no stored user factor is selected
protocol.als_fallback: train popularity when no supplied favorite belongs to the trained catalog
protocol.als_fallback_scope: not exercised by the eligible validation cohort; checked separately with request tests

training_matrix.values: binary; rating magnitude is not a weight
